facts.business: Add Shop E-Retail Limited operates in the distribution and retail of organic fertilizers, animal feed supplements, Ayurveda, feminine hygiene, personal care, books & stationery, and household products.

auditor.name: M/s. K M Chauhan & Associates, Chartered Accountants, Rajkot
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matters: barter activity with customers (selling animal feed and acquiring food grain); trade receivables at 72.24% of revenue from operations indicating high debtor holding period; distribution commission/incentive/bonus of Rs.23,22,86,684.19 booked on total basis without party-wise verification; SEBI interim order cum show cause notice under Sections 11(1), 11(4), 11(4A), 11B(1), 11B(2) of SEBI Act, 1992.

key_risks: High trade receivables (72.24% of revenue from operations) indicating extended debtor holding period
Distribution commission/incentive/bonus expenses booked on aggregate basis without party-wise verification
SEBI interim order cum show cause notice under Sections 11(1), 11(4), 11(4A), 11B(1), 11B(2) of SEBI Act, 1992
Barter transactions involving sale of animal feed and acquisition of food grain
Competition, price sensitivity, and fluctuations in input and transportation costs
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions approved with M/s. Dada Organics Limited for sale/purchase/supply of goods, property transactions, leasing, services, agent appointments, office/place of profit appointments, and underwriting subscriptions.
